## Synopsis

Revokes one admin API token, and its next request is refused. Pass the name
the console shows under Settings, API tokens, or the id strazactl api-token list
prints. An argument in the form of an id is taken as an id. Revoking by name
reads the token list first, so it needs tokens:read as well as tokens:write.

```
strazactl api-token revoke <name-or-id> [flags]
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER)
```
